name: Phase Requirement Mismatch
description: Replaces the standard boolean literal representation with a "phase requirement mismatch" formulation. Instead of saying the schedule must satisfy at least one of two conditions, it states that an assessment is "exposed" (causing failure) if and only if both parameters fail to match their mathematically defined target phases. This forces the model to deduce the logical disjunction rather than pattern-matching standard 2-SAT keywords or descriptions.
